title: Bank Account Management System
problemStatement: Design and implement a simple bank account management system using OOP concepts.
requirements: Create a base Account class with accountNumber, balance, and ownerName
Implement SavingsAccount with interest rate and minimum balance
Support deposit, withdraw, and displayBalance operations
Demonstrate polymorphism by processing different account types
hints: Start with the base Account class and common operations
Use method overriding for withdraw logic
Use a List<Account> to demonstrate polymorphic processing
